headline: Lucid Group (LCID) Starts $1.4 Billion Reset And Pushes Midsize EV To 2027
summary: Lucid Group (NasdaqGS:LCID) announced a US$1.4b cost saving plan as part of a broad operational reset. The company postponed its planned midsize EV launch to 2027 as it reshapes its product roadmap. Lucid Group created a new AI focused business unit to advance autonomous vehicle efforts with partners including Uber and Nuro. headline: SpaceX stock below $100 is a buying opportunity: Panel on end of lockup period
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) stock continues to near $100 per share on Thursday as the space venture's lockup period expires, allowing employees and early investors to sell their stock. Slatestone Wealth chief market strategist Kenny Polcari and AllSource Investment Management founder Patrick Kennedy share their outlook on SpaceX stock value, especially as over 900 million shares get unlocked.
